title: Panda holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M62 38 Q70 55 66 72' stroke='#f7f7f7' stroke-width='2' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='26' rx='13' ry='15' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='21' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#ff8fa3'/>
  <polygon points='62,41 58,47 66,47' fill='#e0324f'/>
  <!-- panda body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='76' rx='19' ry='18' fill='#5b5f8f'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='80' rx='12' ry='12' fill='#f2f2f2'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx='25' cy='68' rx='7' ry='10' fill='#5b5f8f' transform='rotate(25 25 68)'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='66' rx='7' ry='10' fill='#5b5f8f' transform='rotate(-35 60 66)'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='92' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#5b5f8f'/>
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='92' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#5b5f8f'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='44' r='20' fill='#f2f2f2'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='28' r='7' fill='#5b5f8f'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='28' r='7' fill='#5b5f8f'/>
  <!-- eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='44' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#4a4e7a' transform='rotate(-15 34 44)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#4a4e7a' transform='rotate(15 50 44)'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='44' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='44' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='35.5' cy='44.5' r='1.2' fill='#2b2d50'/>
  <circle cx='49.5' cy='44.5' r='1.2' fill='#2b2d50'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='52' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#4a4e7a'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M38 56 Q42 60 46 56' stroke='#4a4e7a' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none'/>
  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <circle cx='29' cy='50' r='2.5' fill='#ffb3c0'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='50' r='2.5' fill='#ffb3c0'/>
</svg>
